title: Cardinal DriveSense Device Agreement — Ownership, Return Request and Non-Return Fee
content:
## Clauses

**1. Ownership.** A Cardinal DriveSense plug-in device stays Cardinal's property.

**2. Return request.** When a plug-in enrollment ends, a return is requested with a due date set the program's device return period after the end date. On Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In and Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In that period is 30 calendar days; the other programs use no device (0).

**3. Non-return fee.** The device non-return fee is charged only when the device has not been received by the return due date. The return due date is the last day a return is accepted without a fee, and the fee may be charged from the next day. When it is charged, the fee is assessed on the device and sent to the customer's Cardinal Billing Account as a device non-return fee.

**4. Device received late.** A device received after the fee was charged has the fee waived through billing.

**5. Device lost in a covered loss.** A device reported lost in a covered total loss or theft carries no fee.

## Fee timing

| Element | Setting |
|---|---|
| Clock starts from | The return due date shown on the device return request |
| Record that decides it | The company's device records for that device, matched by device serial number: the return request with its due date, and any receipt of the device |
| Days added after the due date before the fee may be charged | 0 calendar days |
| Is the due date itself a fee day | No; the due date is the last day a return is accepted without a fee |
| First day the fee may be charged | The day after the return due date |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

A Plug-In enrollment ends on March 10. The return due date is 30 calendar days later: April 9.

| Device status | Date considered | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Received April 9 | — | Not charged: received by the due date |
| Not received | April 9 | Not chargeable yet: the due date is still a day without a fee |
| Not received | April 10 | May be charged: the day after the due date |
| Received April 20, after the fee was charged | — | The fee is waived through billing |
| Reported lost in a covered total loss of the vehicle | — | No fee |

## Points of judgement

- The fee turns on whether the device was received by the due date; the customer's statement that a device was mailed is not a receipt of the device.
- Each device is judged by its own serial number: a return request, a receipt and a fee all belong to one device.
